coverageLimits: Gestione Separata parasubordinate/special-sector codes are present in circular 8 but are not normalized into this bounded source-pack snapshot.

The employee path is intentionally limited to the general agricultural-worker OTD/OTI FPLD profile and contribution bases at or below the 2026 additional-1% threshold; other employee sectors and higher bases remain unsupported.
The €122,295 annual base maximum is retained only as a source-reported reference value; the bounded employee calculator never reaches or applies that ceiling because it fails closed above €56,224.
The employee calculator accepts an already determined FPLD contribution base and does not derive payroll contribution bases from salary, days, collective-contract minima or other remuneration rules.
Industrial agricultural employers, special reductions, NASpI, INAIL and LOAgri are not folded into the bounded employee FPLD calculator.
Downstream calculators must select only an explicitly supported profile and year; no fallback to a nearby profile or year is permitted.
reason: Exact official INPS 2026 source bytes are pinned and hash-addressed, with bounded machine-readable facts for Gestione Separata professionals, artigiani/commercianti and one agricultural-worker employee profile. Unsupported profiles remain explicit rather than inheriting values.
